disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 逐条复核了机器预扫命中清单中所有与密钥/凭据相关的条目（规则 DSH-C01 → DG-R1-51，约 25 处）：命中全部是文档说明、界面输入框占位提示、工具描述与报错文案中对用户自有 OpenSSH 配置（~/.ssh/config、~/.ssh/id_ed25519 等）的引用；引擎代码并不读取这些文件的内容，密钥认证完全由系统 ssh/scp 与 ssh-agent 处理，插件不保存任何凭据。
checked_items.en: Each entry related to credentials/secrets in the machine pre-scan hit list (rule DSH-C01 → DG-R1-51, ~25 items) was reviewed individually: all hits are references to the user's own OpenSSH configuration (~/.ssh/config, ~/.ssh/id_ed25519, etc.) in documentation, UI input placeholders, tool descriptions, and error messages; the engine code does not read the contents of these files, key authentication is entirely handled by the system ssh/scp and ssh-agent, and the plugin does not store any credentials.

checked_items.zh: 唯一会读取真实凭据文件的代码是配套包 dsh-model-tier 的端到端测试脚本（把本机凭据复制进仓库内隔离测试目录并追加测试密钥、退出时清理）：属开发者在本地手动运行的测试工具，不在安装流程中，也无任何外发逻辑。
checked_items.en: The only code that reads real credential files is the end-to-end test script of the companion package dsh-model-tier (which copies local credentials into an isolated test directory in the repo, appends test keys, and cleans them up on exit): this is a test tool manually run by developers locally, not part of the install flow, and has no outbound logic.

checked_items.zh: 未发现钱包/云凭据枚举命令，未发现凭据读取与网络外发组合链。
checked_items.en: No wallet/cloud credential enumeration commands were found, and no combination chain of credential reading plus network exfiltration was found.

evidence.zh: 远程计算引擎不读取也不保存任何凭据：别名、端口、私钥路径等参数仅透传给系统 OpenSSH，密钥认证由 ssh-agent 或用户密钥文件完成；唯一触碰真实凭据的是本地手动测试脚本（复制到隔离目录、退出清理），无外发通道。
evidence.en: The remote computing engine neither reads nor stores any credentials: alias, port, private key path and other parameters are passed through to system OpenSSH only, and key authentication is performed by ssh-agent or the user's key file; the only thing that touches real credentials is a local manual test script (copies to an isolated directory and cleans up on exit), with no exfiltration channel.

checked_items.zh: 逐一审查了全部注册工具（research_*、artifact_*、remote_* 共 31 个）的工具描述、科学模式人格文本、预设指令与 11 个技能文件（机器预扫命中 DSH-X10 → DG-R2-57 的全部 SKILL.md 均已全文复核）：内容均为科研工作流操作指引与工具说明，未发现指令覆写、系统消息伪装、审批绕过、诱导安装/改配置或远程指令加载等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: All registered tools (research_*, artifact_*, remote_*, 31 in total) were reviewed one by one, including tool descriptions, the science mode persona text, preset instructions, and 11 skill files (all SKILL.md files hit by the machine pre-scan DSH-X10 → DG-R2-57 were fully reviewed): the content is all research workflow operation guidance and tool explanations; no injection wording such as instruction override, system message impersonation, approval bypass, induced installation/configuration changes, or remote instruction loading was found.

checked_items.zh: 人格文本中的「会话开始协议」「工作区隔离」等条款属科研工作台正常行为约定，与插件声明业务一致；其中提醒不要用 curl/Playwright 驱动本机 Web GUI 属安全护栏而非注入。
checked_items.en: Provisions in the persona text such as "session start protocol" and "workspace isolation" are normal behavioral conventions of the research workbench and consistent with the plugin's declared business; the reminders not to drive the local Web GUI with curl/Playwright are safety guardrails, not injection.

checked_items.zh: 未发现隐藏字符、零宽字符或混淆指令载体。
checked_items.en: No hidden characters, zero-width characters, or obfuscated instruction carriers were found.

evidence.zh: 全部注册工具的描述与人格文本逐条语义审查，均为科研工作流操作说明，无系统指令、凭证读取诱导或隐藏意图；工具描述会进入模型请求面，但内容干净。
evidence.en: The descriptions and persona text of all registered tools were reviewed semantically one by one; all are research workflow operation descriptions with no system instructions, credential-reading inducement, or hidden intent; tool descriptions do enter the model request surface, but the content is clean.

evidence.zh: 工具描述与技能文件中未发现诱导安装插件、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；人格文本提醒不跨工作区操作、不驱动本机 Web GUI，属安全护栏。
evidence.en: No wording inducing plugin installation, config rewriting, or permission escalation was found in tool descriptions or skill files; the persona text reminds not to operate across workspaces or drive the local Web GUI, which are safety guardrails.

checked_items.zh: YAML 内嵌 JS 表达式核查（规则 DSH-P01 → DG-R3-51）：全树仅两处命中，均在科学模式预设文件里，内容是平台判断（是否为 Windows 以启用 bash/pwsh），表达式为静态常量比较，无任意代码载荷；该机制本身是宿主加载器提供的配置能力，插件未借此执行任何动态内容。
checked_items.en: Check of JS expressions embedded in YAML (rule DSH-P01 → DG-R3-51): only two hits in the whole tree, both in the science mode preset file; the content is a platform check (whether it is Windows to enable bash/pwsh), the expressions are static constant comparisons with no arbitrary code payload; this mechanism itself is a configuration capability provided by the host loader, and the plugin does not use it to execute any dynamic content.

checked_items.zh: 子进程/危险函数核查（规则 DSH-X03 → DG-R3-55）：引擎通过系统 OpenSSH（ssh/scp）与本地 bash 执行远程/本地命令，属声明的远程计算功能；所有连接操作默认经审批闸门，远程路径有字符白名单校验，脚本内容经标准输入落盘而非拼进命令行；一个可选的主机补丁脚本用子进程定位 DSH 安装目录以改写客户端运行时文件，需用户手动运行、有备份与回滚，用途为工作区隔离修复，属良性工具。
checked_items.en: Check of subprocess/dangerous functions (rule DSH-X03 → DG-R3-55): the engine executes remote/local commands via system OpenSSH (ssh/scp) and local bash, which is part of the declared remote computing functionality; all connection operations go through an approval gate by default, remote paths have character whitelist validation, and script content is written to disk via stdin rather than concatenated into the command line; an optional host patch script uses subprocess to locate the DSH install directory and rewrite client runtime files, requires manual user operation, has backup and rollback, and is used for workspace isolation repair—a benign tool.

checked_items.zh: 安装钩子与树内执行载体核查（规则 DSH-X02 未命中、DSH-X07 → DG-R3-59 命中两条工作流）：package.json 无任何安装/构建生命周期钩子；两份 GitHub Actions 工作流为常规分支门禁与打 tag 自动发布（测试+打包+npm 发布），无隐蔽下载执行、无凭据读取。
checked_items.en: Check of install hooks and in-tree execution carriers (rule DSH-X02 not hit, DSH-X07 → DG-R3-59 hit two workflows): package.json has no install/build lifecycle hooks; the two GitHub Actions workflows are routine branch gating and tag-triggered auto-release (test + build + npm publish), with no covert download-and-execute and no credential reading.

checked_items.zh: 客户端 bundle 专项扫描（规则 DSH-X04 命中声明、DSH-X05 未命中）：远程主机设置页客户端为 React 表单 UI，仅调用宿主本地路由，无键盘监听、剪贴板读取或特权 RPC 调用。
checked_items.en: Dedicated scan of the client bundle (rule DSH-X04 hit declaration, DSH-X05 not hit): the client on the remote host settings page is a React form UI that only calls host local routes, with no keyboard listener, clipboard reading, or privileged RPC calls.

checked_items.zh: 未发现 eval/动态解码执行、混淆器签名或 node:vm 动态包调用（规则 DSH-X06/X08/X09 未命中）。
checked_items.en: No eval/dynamic decode execution, obfuscator signatures, or node:vm dynamic package calls were found (rules DSH-X06/X08/X09 not hit).

evidence.zh: 全树 YAML 仅两处内嵌 JS 表达式（科学模式预设文件中的平台判断），均为静态常量比较，用于按操作系统启用 bash/pwsh；无任意代码执行载荷，未发现可被恶意利用的求值入口。
evidence.en: In the whole tree, only two JS expressions are embedded in YAML (platform checks in the science mode preset file); both are static constant comparisons used to enable bash/pwsh by operating system; no arbitrary code execution payload and no exploitable evaluation entry point were found.

evidence.zh: 未发现对动态包工具（在宿主以 vm 执行模型代码的工具）的任何调用，全树无 node:vm 相关代码。
evidence.en: No calls to the dynamic package tool (a tool that executes model code in a vm on the host) were found, and there is no node:vm-related code anywhere in the tree.

evidence.zh: package.json 无安装/构建生命周期钩子；仓库内执行载体仅两份常规 CI/CD 工作流（分支门禁与 tag 发布），内容为测试、打包与 npm 发布，无安装期执行风险。
evidence.en: package.json has no install/build lifecycle hooks; the only in-repo execution carriers are two routine CI/CD workflows (branch gating and tag release), whose content is testing, packaging, and npm publishing, with no install-time execution risk.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器客户端（dsh.client），客户端为远程主机设置页的 React 表单，仅调用宿主本地路由；未发现键盘监听、剪贴板读取、凭证 RPC 等特权行为。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser client (dsh.client); the client is a React form for the remote host settings page and only calls host local routes; no privileged behavior such as keyboard listening, clipboard reading, or credential RPC was found.

checked_items.zh: 外联面枚举：客户端 fetch 全部指向宿主本地路由（/dsh-science/remote-hosts/*、/dsh-model-tier/*）；引擎唯一的外部通信对象是用户显式注册并经审批的 SSH 主机（远程计算业务本身）；未发现任何第三方域名、裸 IP、隧道/带外通道或 AI 端点/代理劫持配置（规则 DSH-C05 → DG-R4-53 的 curl 相关命中均为文档说明与同源校验注释）。
checked_items.en: Outbound surface enumeration: all client fetches point to host local routes (/dsh-science/remote-hosts/*, /dsh-model-tier/*); the engine's only external communication target is SSH hosts explicitly registered by the user and approved (the remote computing business itself); no third-party domains, bare IPs, tunnel/out-of-band channels, or AI endpoint/proxy hijacking configurations were found (the curl-related hits from rule DSH-C05 → DG-R4-53 are all documentation notes and same-origin validation comments).

checked_items.zh: 未发现凭据读取+外联组合链或编码变换外发链；主机探测脚本经 base64 传输仅为规避命令行引号问题，内容是固定的只读系统信息采集脚本，无数据外发。
checked_items.en: No credential-reading + outbound combination chain or encoding-transform exfiltration chain was found; the host probe script is transmitted via base64 only to avoid command-line quoting issues, its content is a fixed read-only system information collection script with no data exfiltration.

evidence.zh: 外联面仅限用户显式注册并经审批的 SSH 主机与宿主本地路由；引擎不读取凭据、无编码变换外发链、无带外通道，未发现凭证外泄路径。
evidence.en: The outbound surface is limited to SSH hosts explicitly registered and approved by the user and host local routes; the engine does not read credentials, has no encoding-transform exfiltration chain, no out-of-band channels, and no credential exfiltration path was found.

checked_items.zh: 依赖面：运行时仅 react（客户端 UI）与同仓配套 bundle dsh-model-tier；无未知第三方依赖、无 typosquatting 迹象，无浮动 git 引用（规则 DSH-S04 未命中）。
checked_items.en: Dependency surface: runtime dependencies are only react (client UI) and the same-repo companion bundle dsh-model-tier; no unknown third-party dependencies, no typosquatting signs, and no floating git references (rule DSH-S04 not hit).

checked_items.zh: patch 文件核查（规则 DSH-P03/P04/P05 未命中）：根 patch 与配套包 patch 仅做引擎行插入，未触碰沙箱/审批/权限安全行、未禁用安全配置、未改写 inject/intercept。
checked_items.en: Patch file check (rules DSH-P03/P04/P05 not hit): the root patch and companion package patch only insert engine lines, do not touch sandbox/approval/permission security lines, do not disable security configs, and do not rewrite inject/intercept.

checked_items.zh: 审批链核查（规则 DSH-S01 未命中）：未对安全事件（工具预执行、审批请求）做抢先监听；配套路由包对宿主默认模型选择的监听为只读观察+恢复性写入，属文档化护栏，不截断审批链。
checked_items.en: Approval chain check (rule DSH-S01 not hit): no preemptive listening on security events (tool pre-execution, approval requests); the companion route package's listener on the host default model selection is read-only observation plus restorative write, a documented guardrail, and does not truncate the approval chain.

checked_items.zh: 版本信号：首次审计无基线可比较（规则 DSH-S02 不适用）；发布流程为常规 CI/CD，无版本突变或升级自动激活风险可对照。
checked_items.en: Version signals: first audit with no baseline to compare (rule DSH-S02 not applicable); the release process is routine CI/CD, with no version jump or upgrade auto-activation risk to compare against.

evidence.zh: 根 patch 与配套包 patch 只插入引擎行，未触碰沙箱/审批/权限配置，未发现禁用安全行或环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: The root patch and companion package patch only insert engine lines, do not touch sandbox/approval/permission config, and no security-disabling lines or environment-variable downgrade patterns were found.

evidence.zh: 未发现对安全事件（工具预执行、审批请求）的抢先监听或截断；未发现可绕过审批链的监听注册。
evidence.en: No preemptive listening on or truncation of security events (tool pre-execution, approval requests) was found; no listener registration that could bypass the approval chain was found.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无上一版本基线可比较，版本间能力声明突变检测不适用。
evidence.en: First audit, no previous-version baseline to compare, so detection of capability-declaration mutations between versions is not applicable.

evidence.zh: patch 未改写 inject/intercept 配置，不会给安全插件追加不存在的必需服务；未发现可致安全插件永久等待的篡改。
evidence.en: The patch does not rewrite inject/intercept config, does not append required services that do not exist to security plugins, and no tampering that could cause security plugins to wait forever was found.

checked_items.zh: webServer 面：插件注册了两组宿主 webServer 前缀路由（远程主机设置页与智能分档设置页），均强制 POST-only 并做 Origin↔Host 同源校验，符合宿主 webserver 既有安全模型；插件未自建监听端口，未扩大宿主无认证 RPC 的固有风险面。
checked_items.en: webServer surface: the plugin registers two groups of host webServer prefix routes (remote host settings page and smart tiering settings page), both are forced POST-only and do Origin↔Host same-origin validation, consistent with the host webserver's existing security model; the plugin does not create its own listening port and does not expand the host's inherent risk surface of unauthenticated RPC.

checked_items.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（L4 未启用），静态与语义审查均未发现运行时异常行为证据。
checked_items.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (L4 not enabled); static and semantic review found no evidence of abnormal runtime behavior.

evidence.zh: 插件未自建 web 服务/监听端口，仅复用宿主 webServer 注册前缀路由并做同源校验，按「不启动服务」记不适用；宿主 webserver 无认证 RPC 属生态固有风险，非本插件引入。
evidence.en: The plugin does not create its own web service/listening port; it only reuses the host webServer's registered prefix routes with same-origin validation, so it is marked as not applicable per "does not start a service"; the host webserver's unauthenticated RPC is an inherent ecosystem risk, not introduced by this plugin.

summary.zh: 包元数据与身份核验通过：package.json 声明 dsh.bundle/dsh.client，作者与仓库信息完整，无名称仿冒或 typosquatting 迹象。
summary.en: Package metadata and identity verification passed: package.json declares dsh.bundle/dsh.client, author and repository info are complete, with no name impersonation or typosquatting signs.

summary.zh: 静态扫描通过：机器预扫命中清单（51 条）逐条复核，全部为良性机制或文档引用；未发现恶意载荷、凭据硬编码或危险调用链。
summary.en: Static scan passed: the machine pre-scan hit list (51 items) was reviewed one by one; all are benign mechanisms or documentation references; no malicious payload, hardcoded credentials, or dangerous call chains were found.

summary.zh: 行为分析通过：无安装钩子、无混淆/动态解码、无凭据外联、无第三方外联域名。
summary.en: Behavior analysis passed: no install hooks, no obfuscation/dynamic decoding, no credential exfiltration, no third-party outbound domains.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查通过：工具描述、人格文本、技能文件均无注入措辞，能力声明与实现一致。
summary.en: AI metadata review passed: tool descriptions, persona text, and skill files contain no injection wording, and capability declarations are consistent with implementation.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证（无沙箱产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed at this stage (no sandbox artifact).

limits.zh: 1) 未做动态沙箱验证（无 l4-sandbox.json）；2) 首版审计，无上一版报告可比较；3) 未逐字通读测试脚本的全部断言与文档细节，仅对安全相关面精读；客户端 bundle 为手写包装产物，已与源码（client/remote-hosts-ui/src/index.js）逐字比对一致；4) 适用性判定：package.json 含 dsh.bundle/dsh.client 声明且依赖配套 dsh bundle，确属 dsh 生态插件，无疑点。
limits.en: 1) No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no l4-sandbox.json); 2) first-version audit, no previous report to compare; 3) did not read every assertion in the test scripts and every documentation detail word by word, only deeply read security-related surfaces; the client bundle is a hand-wrapped build artifact and was compared verbatim with the source (client/remote-hosts-ui/src/index.js); 4) applicability determination: package.json contains dsh.bundle/dsh.client declarations and depends on a companion dsh bundle, so it is indeed a dsh ecosystem plugin with no doubts.
